rules.rule: Display item/order ID, location, route, freshness, assignee, exception state, scan confidence, next handoff, and reversibility beside every scan, route, assign, reconcile, or handoff action.
rules.rationale: Decision context must be visible at the moment of commitment.
rules.failureMode: Missing context causes barcode scan succeeds visually but fails server reconciliation.

rules.rule: Show full package ID in the same visual group as the primary action.
rules.rationale: The highest-risk identifier must travel with the action.
rules.failureMode: The user acts without seeing full package ID.

rules.rule: Label data freshness or status whenever the view contains route boards, scan screens, exception queues, dispatch views, and package lists.
rules.rationale: Users must know whether operational data is current.
rules.failureMode: The interface hides stale context around route boards, scan screens, exception queues, dispatch views, and package lists.

rules.rule: Require a review step before shipment handoff, route reassignment, exception resolution, duplicate scan, and dispatch instruction.
rules.rationale: High-cost actions need an interruption for verification.
rules.failureMode: The user completes shipment handoff, route reassignment, exception resolution, duplicate scan, and dispatch instruction without review.

rules.rule: Block silent changes to critical values after review in scan, route, assign, reconcile, or handoff action.
rules.rationale: Consent depends on the reviewed values staying stable.
rules.failureMode: The UI allows barcode scan succeeds visually but fails server reconciliation.

rules.rule: Provide a recovery or correction path when barcode scan succeeds visually but fails server reconciliation.
rules.rationale: High-cost mistakes need visible next steps.
rules.failureMode: The user cannot recover after barcode scan succeeds visually but fails server reconciliation.

rules.rule: Match density to route boards, scan screens, exception queues, dispatch views, and package lists; do not use decorative spacing that separates labels from values.
rules.rationale: Domain work depends on scanning related facts together.
rules.failureMode: Related labels and values drift apart visually.

rules.rule: Keep required identifiers visible at mobile widths for scan, route, assign, reconcile, or handoff action.
rules.rationale: Narrow screens are common at decision time.
rules.failureMode: Mobile layout hides full package ID.

rules.rule: Do not use decorative motion around scan feedback, assignment, failure, retry, route status, or exception queues.
rules.rationale: Motion must not hide or trivialize domain state.
rules.failureMode: Motion obscures barcode scan succeeds visually but fails server reconciliation.

rules.rule: Provide a reduced-motion path for status changes involving stale-gps-scan-data, duplicate-scan, partial-route-failure, offline-queue, permission-denied-reassignment, damaged-item, handoff-pending, and battery-camera-unavailable.
rules.rationale: State meaning must survive user motion preferences.

rules.rule: Use exact labels for stale, queued, reconciled, duplicate, exception, damaged, handoff, assignee, route, and scan confidence.
rules.rationale: Precise terms map to different user decisions.
rules.failureMode: A vague label masks barcode scan succeeds visually but fails server reconciliation.

rules.rule: Do not use color alone to distinguish stale-gps-scan-data, duplicate-scan, partial-route-failure, offline-queue, permission-denied-reassignment, damaged-item, handoff-pending, and battery-camera-unavailable.
rules.rationale: Status must be perceivable without color vision.
rules.failureMode: Users miss a state among stale-gps-scan-data, duplicate-scan, partial-route-failure, offline-queue, permission-denied-reassignment, damaged-item, handoff-pending, and battery-camera-unavailable.

rules.rule: Provide states for stale-gps-scan-data, duplicate-scan, partial-route-failure, offline-queue, permission-denied-reassignment, damaged-item, handoff-pending, and battery-camera-unavailable.
rules.rationale: Domain flows contain more than loading/success/error.
rules.failureMode: A missing state causes barcode scan succeeds visually but fails server reconciliation.

rules.rule: Use exact labels for stale, queued, reconciled, duplicate, exception, damaged, handoff, assignee, route, and scan confidence.
rules.failureMode: A generic label causes barcode scan succeeds visually but fails server reconciliation.

rules.rule: Define ambiguous values as stale, queued, reconciled, duplicate, exception, damaged, handoff pending, and permission denied.
rules.rationale: Users should not infer whether values are final or provisional.
rules.failureMode: A provisional value is treated as final in scan, route, assign, reconcile, or handoff action.

rules.rule: Provide states for stale-gps-scan-data, duplicate-scan, partial-route-failure, offline-queue, permission-denied-reassignment, damaged-item, handoff-pending, and battery-camera-unavailable.
rules.rationale: Domain flows contain more than loading/success/error.
rules.failureMode: A missing state causes barcode scan succeeds visually but fails server reconciliation.

rules.rule: Preserve user input or task context when recovery is needed after scan, route, assign, reconcile, or handoff action.
rules.rationale: Recovery without preserved context still fails the task.
rules.failureMode: The user must restart after barcode scan succeeds visually but fails server reconciliation.

rules.rule: Expose an empty or unavailable state that explains whether route boards, scan screens, exception queues, dispatch views, and package lists are absent, filtered, stale, or permission denied.
rules.rationale: Empty states need cause and next action.
rules.failureMode: Users cannot distinguish absent data from hidden data.

rules.rule: Keep full package ID visible in confirmation and receipt states.
rules.rationale: Receipts are evidence and recovery anchors.
rules.failureMode: The confirmation omits full package ID.
